title: Kitchen Design Aesthetics and Trends: MasterBrand, Inc. Unveils 2027 Cabinetry Trends and Finish of the Year
summary: MasterBrand, Inc. (NYSE: MBC) released its annual trends report today, informed by more than 2,000 kitchen design experts across North America. The report highlights a shift toward richer, nature-inspired materials, the need for multifunctional spaces and the debut of the 2027 Impactful Finish of the Year, Kanga*. Together, these trends reflect a growing desire for kitchens that balance functionality with warmth and personalization.
